tools.description: Returns aggregated error patterns from error_logs across all users (anonymized). Useful for understanding where learners actually struggle.

tools.name: cl_get_adaptation_summary
tools.description: Returns a summary of fossilization interventions — which patterns are being escalated and whether they are resolving. Shows max tier reached, total interventions, and resolution counts.

tools.name: cl_get_reading_questions
tools.description: Returns reading comprehension questions, optionally filtered by CEFR level. Shows passage text, question, answer options, and correct index. Useful for auditing question quality and level coverage.

tools.name: cl_get_stress_pairs
tools.description: Returns stress minimal pairs — words where stress placement changes meaning (e.g., CÁsă vs caSĂ). Core pronunciation training data.

tools.name: cl_get_suggested_questions
tools.description: Returns AI tutor conversation starter questions, optionally filtered by CEFR level or category. Useful for auditing prompt quality and topic coverage.

tools.name: cl_get_tutor_openings
tools.description: Returns tutor opening messages keyed by self-assessment level. Shows how the AI tutor greets learners at different proficiency levels.

tools.name: cl_add_reading_question
tools.description: Inserts a new reading comprehension question into the reading_questions table. Provide a passage, question, answer options, and the index of the correct answer.

tools.name: cl_get_session_summary
tools.description: Returns aggregated session data — session counts by type, average duration, and content engagement. All data is anonymized (no user IDs returned). Useful for understanding how learners actually use the app.

tools.name: cl_get_proficiency_trends
tools.description: Returns proficiency score history over time — overall, listening, reading, speaking, writing scores by period. Anonymized across all users. Useful for tracking whether content improvements translate to learner gains.

tools.name: cl_get_feature_exposure
tools.description: Returns aggregated feature exposure data — how many times each grammar feature has been seen by learners, with correctness rates. Anonymized. Useful for finding undertaught or poorly-performing features.

tools.name: cl_get_mystery_items
tools.description: Returns mystery vocabulary items — words learners encountered and flagged for exploration. Shows word, context, definition, examples, grammar info, and whether the learner has explored it. Useful for understanding organic vocabulary discovery.

tools.name: cl_get_generated_content_summary
tools.description: Returns aggregated stats on AI-generated content — what types are being generated, for which error targets, listening rates, and estimated TTS costs. Anonymized. Useful for auditing the AI tutor's output quality and cost.

tools.name: cl_get_learning_narratives
tools.description: Returns AI-generated learning narrative summaries — periodic reflections on learner progress with stats. Anonymized. Useful for auditing narrative quality and checking if the reflection system captures meaningful patterns.

tools.name: cl_get_tts_usage
tools.description: Returns TTS (text-to-speech) usage stats — characters consumed per day. Useful for monitoring costs and usage trends.
